name: Lumin Airwave 216 RGB
analog: Lian Li Lancool 216 RGB (docs only, never shown in game)
desc: Airflow mid-tower with a fine-mesh front and two big 160 mm ARGB intake fans.

specs.fans_included: 2 x 160 mm ARGB front + 1 x 120 mm ARGB rear

doc_notes: Peel the protective film off both sides of the glass side panel before you close the case.
Six brass standoffs come pre-installed (ATX holes A, C, F, H, K, M); fit the other three (G, J, L) from the bag for a full ATX board.
Screw bag: 9 x #6-32 standoffs and board screws, 12 x M3 SSD screws, 16 x fan screws, 10 cable ties.
Fans: 2 x 160 mm front intake (A_FAN_1-2), 1 x 120 mm rear exhaust (A_FAN_0).
Front panel header: POWER SW, RESET SW, POWER LED +/-, HDD LED +/-; match the + marks on the board's F_PANEL.
The PSU goes in fan-down over the bottom dust filter; four #6-32 screws through the rear wall.
Remove the slot covers your graphics card needs; keep their screws for the card bracket.
Two 2.5 inch SSD mounts: the sled on the PSU shroud and the tray behind the motherboard.

name: Arctiq P12 PWM 120 mm (5-pack)
analog: Arctic P12 PWM PST, 5-pack (docs only, never shown in game)
desc: Five quiet, high-pressure 120 mm PWM fans. The best value cooling you can buy.
doc_notes: Peel the clear film off the hub sticker before use.
Mount with the four fan screws through the corner holes (105 mm spacing); screws fit from either face.
Airflow goes from the sticker side to the strut side; the arrows on the frame show airflow and rotation.
Plug the 4-pin PWM cable into a SYS_FAN or CPU_FAN header: pin 1 GND, 2 +12 V, 3 TACH, 4 PWM.
Rated 1800 rpm max, 22.5 dB(A); set the fan curve in the BIOS.
Box contents: 5 fans, 20 screws.
